data.name: Lameesah
data.gender_notes: Lameesah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The fragrance of Jasmine. The name Lameesah carries the meaning “Jasmine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lameesah usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lameesah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jasmine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lameesah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: لميسه
in_arabic.long_meaning: لميسه اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني اللطيفة الجميلة، والمحبوبة من قبل الناس، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة النور الآية 32، حيث وصف الله تعالى زوجات النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بأنهن 'نساء لطيفات'، ووردت أيضا في الحديث النبوي الشريف 'إن الله يرفع عنها كل سوء ويسميها لطيفة'.

in_urdu.name: لمیسہ
in_urdu.meaning: لمیسہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور پیاری
in_urdu.long_meaning: لمیسہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور پیاری، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے، اور اس کا تعلق عربی جڑوں سے ہے، خاص طور پر 'ل م س' جڑ سے جس کا مطلب ہے 'چھونے' یا 'پیار کرنا'، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: लमीसाह
in_hindi.meaning: लमीसाह का अर्थ है सुंदर और प्रिय
in_hindi.long_meaning: लमीसाह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और प्रिय, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, और इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं, विशेष रूप से 'ल म स' जड़ से जिसका अर्थ है 'स्पर्श करना' या 'प्यार करना', यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है.

in_pashto.name: لميسه
in_pashto.meaning: لميسه د ښکل او محبت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: لميسه د عربي نوم دی چې د ښکل او محبت معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو تر منځ ډیر مشهور دی، او د 'ل م س' ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د 'لمس' یا 'مینه' معنی لري، دا نوم د پښتنو په دودیزو نومونو کې ډیر اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Lameesah
in_english.meaning: Beautiful and beloved, gentle and lovely
in_english.long_meaning: Lameesah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'beautiful and beloved', 'gentle' or 'lovely'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'l-m-s' which means 'to touch' or 'to love'. The name has historical significance in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in various forms across Muslim cultures. It symbolizes kindness, beauty, and affection.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: لميسه

data.cultural_impact: The name "Lameesah" is rooted in Arabic culture, stunningly beautiful, and has an evocative meaning that represents the captivating scent of Jasmine flowers. Jasmine is a common and beloved flower throughout the Middle East and North Africa, and it has historically held significant cultural importance. In many Arab countries, Jasmine tea is a celebrated beverage, and its fragrance is often used in traditional perfumes and as a symbol of love, honor, and elegance. The Islamic name "Lameesah" carries on this rich cultural heritage by invoking the allure and beauty of Jasmine flowers and their precious scent.
data.spiritual_significance: The Islamic name "Lameesah" carries spiritual significance in the broader perspective of Allah's creation, as it underscores one of the many wonders that Allah has bestowed upon nature. The name calls to mind the blooming Jasmine flowers, which are not just lovely to the human senses but also serve as a reminder of Allah's mercy and generosity. The pure and sweet scent of Jasmine represents the divine beauty and nearness of Allah, as well as the connection between the natural world and our spiritual lives. By giving a child the name "Lameesah," parents are not only expressing their admiration for the beauty of creation but also embedding a spiritual reminder of Allah's boundless love and generosity within their child's identity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Jasmine" symbolizes The fragrance of Jasmine. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Lameesah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of jasmine.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Lameesah was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Lameesah carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Lameesah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
